description: Steel Mind built a 97,888 sq ft PEB crane and mezzanine shed for Haier at Raiwind: 33 ft high, 182 ft wide and 532 ft long.
keyword: PEB crane and mezzanine shed in Pakistan
h1: PEB Crane and Mezzanine Shed for Haier at Raiwind: 97,888 Square Feet Under One Roof
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered crane and mezzanine shed for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore. The shed is 33 feet high, 182 feet wide and 532 feet long and covers 97,888 square feet. It is the largest project Steel Mind has built.
alt: PEB crane and mezzanine shed built by Steel Mind for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore.

faq.q: How big is the crane and mezzanine shed?
faq.a: It covers 97,888 square feet, with a width of 182 feet and a length of 532 feet.

faq.q: Can one building have both cranes and a mezzanine?
faq.a: Yes, if the design includes both from the start.

blocks.text: This building joins two systems in one structure: overhead cranes for heavy lifting and a mezzanine for extra floor area. Both place heavy loads on the frame, so the design had to treat them together from the first drawing.

The crane columns and runway beams carry the crane loads, and the mezzanine columns and beams carry the floor loads. The engineer checks that the lower floor keeps enough clear height under the mezzanine and that the cranes keep enough height above it. The foundation is designed with the steel, and the anchor bolt plan guides the foundation contractor.
Steel Mind can combine cranes and a mezzanine in one very large building and deliver it through one team. It is the main example of the company's turnkey method at scale.
